title: Hot Spicy Chinese Fish Dumplings
description: Garlicky and juicy Chinese fish dumplings featuring cornstarch, perfect for adventurous eaters, this Sichuan dish is a pescatarian-friendly delight.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine fish fillets, cornstarch, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, Sichuan pepper, and salt, and mix until just combined.
Knead the mixture for about 5 minutes until it becomes sticky and cohesive.
Divide the mixture into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the dumplings.
Cook the dumplings for about 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and drain off excess water.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
